So LHS = (1 - x) + (-x) + (-x - 1) = -3x

import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem algebra_absxm1pabsxpabsxp1eqxp2_0leqxleq1
  (x : ℝ)
  (h₀ : abs (x - 1) + abs x + abs (x + 1) = x + 2) :
  0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Case analysis on the sign of x-1, x, and x+1
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ x := by
    by_contra hx
    -- If x < 0, then |x| = -x
    have h₂ : x < 0 := by linarith
    have h₃ : abs x = -x := by rw [abs_of_neg h₂]
    have h₄ : abs (x - 1) = 1 - x := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos] <;> linarith
    have h₅ : abs (x + 1) ≥ 0 := abs_nonneg _
    calc
      x + 2 = abs (x - 1) + abs x + abs (x + 1) := by rw [h₀]
      _ = (1 - x) + (-x) + abs (x + 1) := by rw [h₄, h₃]
      _ = 1 - 2 * x + abs (x + 1) := by ring
      _ ≥ 1 - 2 * x := by linarith [abs_nonneg (x + 1)]
      _ > 1 - 2 * 0 := by nlinarith
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
      _ > x + 2 := by linarith
    <;> linarith
  
  have h₂ : x ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hx
    -- If x > 1, then |x-1| = x-1, |x| = x, |x+1| = x+1
    have h₃ : x > 1 := by linarith
    have h₄ : abs (x - 1) = x - 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    have h₅ : abs x = x := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    have h₆ : abs (x + 1) = x + 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    calc
      x + 2 = abs (x - 1) + abs x + abs (x + 1) := by rw [h₀]
      _ = (x - 1) + x + (x + 1) := by rw [h₄, h₅, h₆]
      _ = 3 * x := by ring
      _ > 3 * 1 := by nlinarith
      _ = 3 := by norm_num
      _ > x + 2 := by linarith
    <;> linarith
  
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
